mapper.update: UPDATE banner_tbl SET banner_img = NULL, banner_color = NULL, banner_url = NULL WHERE banner_id = #{num}
mapper.select: SELECT main_link_id AS id, main_link_url AS url FROM main_link_tbl ORDER BY main_link_id
SELECT post_id AS postId, post_title AS postTitle FROM post_tbl WHERE post_type = #{type} ORDER BY post_id DESC
SELECT post_id FROM notice_tbl WHERE post_type = #{postType}

SELECT b.booth_id AS boothId, b.booth_name AS name, b.booth_img AS img, b.booth_hover_img AS hoverImg, b.booth_pw AS pw, b.booth_owner AS owner, b.booth_owner_link AS ownerLink, b.booth_user1 AS user1, b.booth_user1_link AS user1Link, b.booth_user2 AS user2, b.booth_user2_link AS user2Link, b.booth_user3 AS user3, b.booth_user3_link AS user3Link,
-- 태그는 최대 6개까지 MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN tag_name END) AS tag1, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN tag_name END) AS tag2, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN tag_name END) AS tag3, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN tag_name END) AS tag4, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 5 THEN tag_name END) AS tag5, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 6 THEN tag_name END) AS tag6
FROM booth_tbl b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.booth_id, t.tag_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.booth_id ORDER BY t.tag_name) AS rn FROM booth_tag_map_tbl m JOIN booth_tag_tbl t ON m.tag_id = t.tag_id ) tags ON b.booth_id = tags.booth_id
GROUP BY b.booth_id, b.booth_name, b.booth_img, b.booth_hover_img, b.booth_pw, b.booth_owner, b.booth_owner_link, b.booth_user1, b.booth_user1_link, b.booth_user2, b.booth_user2_link, b.booth_user3, b.booth_user3_link
ORDER BY b.booth_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booth_tbl ( booth_name, booth_img, booth_hover_img, booth_pw, booth_owner, booth_owner_link, booth_user1, booth_user1_link, booth_user2, booth_user2_link, booth_user3, booth_user3_link ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{img}, #{hoverImg}, #{pw}, #{owner}, #{ownerLink}, #{user1}, #{user1Link}, #{user2}, #{user2Link}, #{user3}, #{user3Link} )
mapper.update: UPDATE booth_tbl SET booth_name = #{name}, booth_img = #{img}, booth_hover_img = #{hoverImg}, booth_pw = #{pw}, booth_owner = #{owner}, booth_owner_link = #{ownerLink}, booth_user1 = #{user1}, booth_user1_link = #{user1Link}, booth_user2 = #{user2}, booth_user2_link = #{user2Link}, booth_user3 = #{user3}, booth_user3_link = #{user3Link} WHERE booth_id = #{boothId}
mapper.select: SELECT qna_id AS qnaId, user_id AS userId, qna_user_name AS qnaUserName, qna_pw AS qnaPw, qna_img AS qnaImg, qna_content AS qnaContent, qna_secret AS qnaSecret, answer_content AS answerContent, qna_date AS qnaDate FROM qna_tbl ORDER BY qna_id DESC;

SELECT user_id as userId, user_email as userEmail, user_booth_name as userBoothName, user_phone as userPhone, user_role as role, user_date as userDate FROM user_tbl WHERE user_role != 'ADMIN' ORDER BY user_date ASC
